description.text:
The Black & White Trainer Kit, released on 12 September 2011 in English and European languages only, held two 30-card half decks, Excadrill and Zoroark, with a Black & White booster pack, a deck box, a rule book, counters, a coin, a playmat and a Trainer Kit Guide for each half deck. It had been planned for 3 August 2011, in time to be legal for that year's World Championships, but was delayed. The cards are reprints from Black & White and Emerging Powers with the kit's own set symbol and no rarity mark, numbered in the order the guide's example battle draws them. Excadrill and Zoroark, holo and non-holo, have artwork different from their Emerging Powers cards, and the Energy lacks the checkerboard of the Black & White Energy. In the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online, the kit's code unlocked the two halves combined as the Night Hunter theme deck.

The Zoroark half deck runs on Darkness Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.
